content.text: top of pageCentral Plains Roofing Residential & Commercial Roofing ​CALL NOWYou can trust us to provide in-depth product knowledge, professional installation, competitive pricing, and a "satisfaction guaranteed" attitude in every facet of customer service.ServicesComplete overhaul of your roof, gutters and downspouts, quick roof repairs All of your roofing needs in one phone callRe-RoofA Re-Roof seems hectic and confusing dealing with many roofing contractors, insurance adjustors and overwhelming insurance paperwork. Leave it to the professional to figure out how your insurance works and how we at Central Plains Roofing is going to accommodate all you needs and wants with a brand new roof over your head.Gutters & DownspoutsInstalling a new gutter system can be one of the least expensive, but most critical, of all home repairs. Improving the drainage around the home can have a significant impact on the stability of the foundation and the life of the home. It is essential to have a properly functioning gutter system that diverts water away from the home.Roof RepairsA roof repair is like having a broken arm, you have to fix it now and want it to heal properly. Sometimes all you need is a quick patch to get your roof back in proper working order. Anything from a simple shingle repair to faulty flashing from damaged or lifted decking, we even do chimney caps to make sure no water is leaking in your fire place causing major structural damage.Call 816-591-4416Email tim@centralplainsroofing.comAbout UsRoofing ExpertsWe offer residential roofing and commercial roofing installation, utilizing the finest roofing products with highly experienced and trained installers. We pride ourselves in our quality assurance system to make sure every project is finished with complete customer satisfaction. We follow a detailed project flow on all roofing and exterior projects to ensure that when completed we will all be proud of your project. We have built our business on referrals and we seek the approval and admiration of your neighbours and friends as our future referralsbottom of page
